title: Taco Bell Bong
blurb: The Taco Bell bong — the resonant bell that ends every Taco Bell ad and, somehow, became a beloved meme sound. Editors drop it after anything that could conceivably end a commercial: a punchline, a life decision, a catastrophic failure presented with confidence. It carries an odd finality, like the universe signing off on whatever just happened.
origin: The gong sting from Taco Bell's commercials; adopted as an all-purpose closing punctuation.
